summary: Iteration 3: tested voice-only Echo with OpenAI TTS (male/female), multilingual replies and the removal of typed chat. Backend: 9/9 new tests and 33/33 regression tests pass. /api/voice/speak returns 200 audio/mpeg for both voices, including Hindi and Spanish text, and the male and female audio differ, so the man's voice bug is fixed. /api/echo/chat with language=Hindi replies in Devanagari script and Spanish replies in Spanish. Frontend: I mocked window.SpeechRecognition to send a final result. The full loop works: listening -> POST /echo/chat {voice_mode:true, language:'Hindi'} -> Hindi echo turn -> POST /voice/speak {voice:'male'} 200 audio/mpeg -> 'echo is speaking'. Recognition lang is set to hi-IN. All other requested checks pass: chooser, 18 languages, persistence after reload, pause/resume/change/end, /voice->/echo redirect, home-voice-btn and chat-input gone, previous turns load into the transcript, exit modal stay/leave, farewell leave sends DELETE /api/session and clears identity, empty room vent POST.

issues: The top bar is crowded: the voice-header text 'echo · her voice · english' touches the '← back' and 'close ×' buttons with no gap, so it reads '← BACKECHO · HER VOICE · ENGLISHCLOSE ×'. Hide voice-header below md (hidden md:inline) or move it to its own line.

action_items: Fix the crowded mobile header on /echo (voice-header runs into the back/close buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceChatScreen: /echo/history is fetched 2x per mount because of the StrictMode double effect. Harmless, but the effect could be guarded.
voice_speak: Gemini fallback runs on any OpenAI failure. Gemini quota is exhausted, so a 429 'voice is busy' would reach the client, which already handles it with a notice. OK.
fetchSpeech comment still says 'Returns an audio Blob (WAV)'. It is now MP3. Cosmetic.
server.py: logger is defined at the bottom of the module but used inside functions. Works at runtime. Consider moving it to the top.
seed_data_creation: Only temporary sessions; the test fixture deletes them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Tests that drive the voice UI should mock SpeechRecognition with page.add_init_script (FakeRec with start() that emits onresult {resultIndex:0, results:[{0:{transcript}, isFinal:true}]} then onend). This must run before the app loads, because SpeechRec is captured at module load. OpenAI TTS (coral/onyx, tts-1) returns audio/mpeg. Gemini fallback 429s by design. Keep TTS calls modest. Typed chat (AIChatScreen, chat-input, home-voice-btn) was removed on purpose.
